title: Build Plan: Wait Clocks, Visual Checks, Page Sending And Pictures
eyebrow: Build plan · 13 steps in 4 phases, nothing built yet

short.lead: Thirteen steps in four phases, built one phase at a time with each step proved on a planted failure; I need your answer to one choice and your approval.
short.hint: Tap a phase to see it.
items: Issues 556 to 559: pictures built into the page, a check of a copy opened alone, the send rule, and the end-of-turn check that a page was sent, which rebuilds old pages when they are sent.
Nothing from you until the early check.

items.alt: Four build phases in order; phase 1 is checked by you early while the rest keep building
items.caption: Build order.

items: Issues 560 to 563: a settings file for deadlines, waitfor.py, refusing background launches with no deadline, and the rule text.
Issues 564 to 567: visualcheck.py, video and frame sheets, the criteria and visual-loop skill with reviewer rounds, and the end-of-turn visual gate.
Issue 568: the checks that tie each rule to its text, docs, the decisions entry, the token-cost measurement, the version number and the QA page.
Nothing from you until the QA page arrives; then tell me whether QA passed.
The build starts on branch ajsagent/eloquent-mayer-0ayp82, at most two builders at a time.
Pick your answer under Choices, then send the approval line.

changes: new
#556 Pictures step 1: build pictures into the page file
make_page.py stops writing a pictures folder and embeds each picture.
Done when: a built page has no -pics link and no sibling folder is written; an oversized picture and a web link are refused with the reason; the new verify.py cases and the full verify.py pass.
new
#557 Pictures step 2: check a copy opened alone
After each build, a copy opened in an empty folder must show every picture.
Done when: a page with a folder-linked picture fails and names it, a page with embedded pictures passes, and a run over docs/plans lists the six old pages that need repair.
new
#558 Page sending step 1: the send rule and the builder's send line
One rule sentence, and the builder ends its output with the send step.
Done when: the build output ends with the send line, the reminder fires once per page write, and the rules-size and duplication checks pass.
chg
#559 Page sending step 2: block once at turn end, repair on send
A made or changed page that was not sent blocks the turn once, naming it.
Done when: cases prove a never-sent page blocks once then passes, a page changed after sending blocks once, a sent page passes, and a folder-picture page is rebuilt on send.
new
#560 Wait clock step 1: a settings file for deadlines
rules/waits.json holds the numbers; the command-blocking hook reads them from there.
Done when: changing a number or an environment variable changes the hook's behaviour in a case, and an unreadable file is reported in words with defaults used.
new
#561 Wait clock step 2: waitfor.py
A script that checks every minute and ends as done, failed, stalled or timed out.
Done when: run against a real hanging process, a stalled one and a finishing one, it reports timed out, stalled and done with the right exit codes and the first check at 60 seconds.
chg
#562 Wait clock step 3: refuse background launches with no deadline
The hook refuses them and names the fix; an unchecked wait is reported once.
Done when: a background command with no timeout is refused with the fix, one inside its deadline passes, and an unchecked wait is reported once at turn end.
chg
#563 Wait clock step 4: the rule text and agent prompts
A short rule section and a detail file; the old wait wording is moved, not copied.
Done when: the rules-size, duplication and mapping checks pass, and the injected rules grow only by the new section, measured with measure_footprint.py.
new
#564 Visual loop step 1: visualcheck.py doctor and screenshots
Phone and desktop screenshots in light and dark, with a report of errors.

Done when: doctor names a missing tool in words, shots writes four screenshots (phone and desktop, light and dark) and a report, and a test page with sideways scroll and a console error fails both checks.
new
#565 Visual loop step 2: video, frame sheet and motion
A recorded video, a timestamped frame sheet and measured motion.
Done when: an animated test page gives frames that differ, a frozen animation is flagged, and the Unity route is written down and labelled UNTESTED.
new
#566 Visual loop step 3: criteria, the skill and reviewer rounds
Capture the page, have a reviewer critique it, fix it, and repeat, for at most four rounds, without asking you anything.
Done when: on a test page with seeded sideways scroll the loop finds it, fixes it and passes in round two with no input; an unfixable test page ends at round four with a written list.
chg
#567 Visual loop step 4: the end-of-turn visual gate
A real capture report and a record of what was checked replace the keyword match.

Done when: a changed visual file with no report is flagged, one with a report and record passes, a keyword in a command no longer counts, and the false-alarm count over recorded sessions is written down.
chg
#568 Docs, tests and version
Every doc, mapping and test brought in line, then the QA page.
Done when: the full verify.py and tools/verify_tools.py pass, the QA page is linked and sent, and you have said QA passed.
choices: When should you check the work?
One check at the end, when all four phases are built
Fewest interruptions. If page sending or pictures are wrong, it shows up late.
An early check after phase 1, while phases 2 to 4 keep building
Page sending and pictures answer your most repeated complaints and are the quickest to check. It does not pause the build.
B gets the fixes you asked about most into your hands first, and nothing waits on your answer.
